evidence.title: Range Slider · React motion component · beUI

name: Range Slider · beUI
summary: Animated React range slider with tick dots and a bouncing thumb, plus inline, fluid, wave, bubble and ruler variants.
description: Docs page for beUI's motion range sliders: step-snapping values, tick markers, inline labels, a bubble that leans with drag speed, an equalizer-style wave fill and an iOS-style ruler that settles on the nearest tick. Drag and keyboard controlled, reduced-motion safe, with an API reference for step, ticks, labels, units and value formatting; copy the source or install with shadcn.
